title: Existence of the normalized scalar Roos lift
statement: The realization and constant-tower transpose construction produces a scalar-extended strict Roos map with zero shifted coordinate, normalized quotient coordinates, and the displayed factorization through the scalar counit.

proof.text: Apply the proved core with the existing source zero-shift hypothesis hf. Apply factorization_from_coordinates directly to the resulting lift and coordinate predicate, with the same hf.

proof_origin.place: Direct construction and coordinate factorization in Proposition 3.5.1; remove the duplicate factorization wrappers
